title: Asks what the ride costs mid-intake
persona: Tony Russo, regular guy booking for a wedding anniversary. Friendly, a bit nervous about money.
goal: Get a price for the ride, then finish the booking.
opening_line: Hi, I want a limo for Saturday night, for my anniversary.

turns.caller: Pickup is 123 Main Street, Racine. Around six.
We're going to the Pfister Hotel in Milwaukee.
How much is that gonna run me?

branches.if_agent: Says it cannot quote and dispatch will follow up
branches.caller: Hm. Okay, just ballpark, like a hundred, two hundred?

turns.caller: Stretch limo if you got it.
So someone will tell me the price later?

curveballs: Pushes for a ballpark after refusal
hesitation_rules: Says 'oh, uh' before asking the price.
expected: Does not give any number or range for the fare
Explains the team or dispatch handles pricing
Resumes intake after the cost question
Captures vehicle, passengers, name and cell
Does not re-ask pickup or drop-off
must_not: Agree with the caller's guessed range
